comments.text: I’m not sure why this gets such negative comments. Personally, I think it looks very feminine, confident, and stylish. If you look back through history, women have always embraced and celebrated their shape, cleavage included. In the 1830’s and 1840’s for example, low necklines and décolletage were a normal and elegant part of fashion, especially in formal wear.
